_note: PUBLIC SAMPLE - every animal, facility, person, place, number and note in this file is invented. Pebble is a harbor seal born in rehabilitation at Tern Point, released, restranded entangled, and since 2018 held by Gullstone Bay Aquarium for her owner, the Coastal Pinniped Trust. She carries every field the format defines except the ones only a dead animal has, which are in skerry.json (her dam). Records whose originRef starts TP- were recorded at Tern Point and came to Gullstone in an earlier passport: they keep Tern Point's originRef and name it in recordedAt. Media sha256 values are digests of no real file. Phone numbers use the fictional 555-01xx range, the transponder the 999 test prefix. The taxonomy ids are the real ITIS and GBIF ids for Phoca vitulina. The package is one zip - this file as passport.json, the media under media/.

sexHistory.comments: Sexed at the first neonatal exam.
Pup found with her dam at first light; not yet sexed.

identifiers.comments: Named by the keepers for the small round scar on her muzzle.

identifiers.removalComments: Torn out in the entanglement; the site healed clean.

parents.comments: Stranded pregnant in May 2017 and pupped in rehabilitation.

rearings.comments: Tube-fed fish slurry for nine days after the second stranding, then hand-fed whole fish.
Nursed by her dam in the rehabilitation pool until weaning on 2017-07-02.

transactions.comments: Moved with PV-15-01 when the new habitat opened.
Arrived from Tern Point by road, four hours in transit, no sedation. Deemed non-releasable (left eye).
Restranded entangled, six months after release.

geo.description: Gravel bar below the north jetty
geo.weather: Overcast, light rain, wind SW 10 kn

rescue.confirmation: Confirmed by the Tern Point responder on scene.
rescue.fisheryInteractionDetails: Gillnet fragment around the neck and left fore flipper; pot buoy line trailing.
rescue.humanInteractionDetails: Fishing gear entanglement; flipper tag TP 0417 missing.
rescue.gearList: Gillnet fragment, pot buoy line, hook and leader
rescue.gearDescriptionList: Green nylon gillnet panel about 40 x 60 cm, 9 cm mesh; yellow buoy line about 3 m.
rescue.otherGear: J hook on a short monofilament leader
rescue.gearCollectedDetails: Bagged and kept for the fisheries office.
rescue.gearRemovedDetails: Cut free on the beach under manual restraint.

transactions.comments: Released at 100 days with flipper tag TP 0417.

geo.description: Sand beach south of the Tern Point light

animalNotes.noteText: Pebble shifts to the holding pool on the recall whistle. She sees poorly on her left, so present fish and approach from her right side.
Group of three settled after the pool refill. PV-15-01 displaces Pebble at the haul-out most mornings; no injuries seen.

cases.complaint: Squinting and discharge from the left eye.
Raised nodules on the head and fore flippers.

clinicalNotes.noteText: Pre-transfer exam under operant conditioning, no sedation. Weight 61.4 kg, body condition 3 of 5. Left cornea scarred, no discharge. Blood drawn - see lab results.

Started an ophthalmic antibiotic.

Ofloxacin 0.3% ophthalmic, 1 drop in the left eye every 8 hours for 7 days, from 2026-08-30.
Nodules on PV-17-02 and PV-15-01 consistent with seal pox. Staff to glove; separate towels.

nutritionNotes.noteText: Herring changed to a new supplier lot; thiamine and vitamin E supplements unchanged.
Moved to the adult maintenance diet; energy goal 50 kcal per kg.

medicalAlerts.alertText: Limited vision in the left eye - approach and present fish from her right.
Seal pox lesions - glove; separate towels.

chronicConditions.detailedDescription: Healed ulcer from the 2018 entanglement; limited vision on the left.

drugReactions.comments: Both seals had loose stool for two days on the 2019 course; not a contraindication.

prescriptions.instructions: Give inside a herring at the first feed.
1 drop in the left eye every 8 hours.
prescriptions.deliveryComments: Apply at the eye station; reward after.

prescriptions.instructions: Quarterly dewormer, dose on the current weight.

anesthesias.reason: Dental exam and skull radiographs - worn right upper canine.
anesthesias.endotrachealTubeComments: Cuffed; placed on the first attempt.

catheters.comments: Fluids at 5 mL/kg/h through the procedure.

complications.comments: Heart rate fell to 38/min at intubation; resolved with a lighter plane.

recoveryObservations.comments: Back to the dry holding area.

anesthesias.summary: Smooth procedure; worn canine left in place, recheck in a year.

anesthesias.reason: Lance an abscess on the right hind flipper.

anesthetics.comments: Would not station on the haul-out.

labCollections.comments: Drawn from the rear flipper during the trained presentation.

tests.comments: Hematocrit at the low end, as in her past results.
tests.textResults: No blood parasites seen on the smear.

measurements.comments: Scale out of service; estimated by two keepers.

contraceptions.comments: Deslorelin implant, dorsal neck; kept from the adult male for three weeks.

observations.comments: Neck fold present, hips not visible.

processes.name: Ice block with herring
processes.summary: Process 'Ice block with herring' - status Approved; taxa Pinnipeds; safety supervision: keeper present until it melts.

processes.name: Floating hose ring
processes.summary: Process 'Floating hose ring' - status Approved; taxa Pinnipeds.

records.comments: Pushed the block to the shallows to work at it.

behaviors.name: Voluntary blood draw
behaviors.behaviorGoal: Present a rear flipper and hold still 60 seconds for venipuncture.
behaviors.completedBehaviorDescription: Lies ventral on the mat, rear flippers together, holds through needle placement and draw.

behaviors.name: Stretcher entry
behaviors.behaviorGoal: Enter the stretcher and lie still.

undesirableBehavior.comments: Mouthed the mat twice; not reinforced.

questions.question: Social behavior
questions.comments: Displaced at the haul-out by PV-15-01 most mornings.

questions.question: Activity level
questions.comments: Hot week; less time in the water.

actionPlans.reason: Move to a new group under the owner's pinniped plan.
actionPlans.description: Pre-shipment exam, crate training, transport booking and the records transfer to the receiving facility.

notes.noteText: Crate training at 80 percent; she enters and lies down on cue.

digitalImaging.diagnosis: Worn right upper canine, no root abscess.

diets.comments: Whole fish thawed under refrigeration; supplements in the first feed.
